description: This file implements the HeartbeatProcedure class and related classes for managing heartbeat signals in a server context, including factory creation, handling ping events, and cleanup logic.

classes.name: HeartbeatProcedure
classes.description: Main class managing heartbeat logic, including creation of handlers, tracking pings sent, and cleanup.

classes.name: HeartbeatProcedure::HeartbeatHandler
classes.description: Nested class handling individual heartbeat ping events, success/failure, and lifecycle callbacks.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a new HeartbeatProcedureFactory instance.

methods.name: createHeartbeatProcedure
methods.description: Creates a new HeartbeatProcedure instance with specified ackSender and pingId.

methods.name: HeartbeatHandler::HeartbeatHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing a heartbeat handler with procedure, controlId, and pingId.

methods.name: HeartbeatHandler::~HeartbeatHandler
methods.description: Destructor that signals the procedure that the heartbeat has finished.

methods.name: pingSent
methods.description: Marks that a ping has been sent for a specific controlId.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the pingId associated with this heartbeat.

methods.name: HeartbeatProcedure
methods.description: Constructor initializing the heartbeat with ackSender and pingId.

methods.name: HeartbeatProcedure::~HeartbeatProcedure
methods.description: Destructor that sends the final heartbeat status via ackSender.
